violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage (26 TAC §747.3109(c))
violation_type.short_title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Provide Safe Storage
violation_type.typical_finding: A meal that was provided by a parent for their child was halved and shared with another child in care. The meal was not intended for two children.
